mapper.select: SELECT q.*, c.name AS category_name FROM question q LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = q.category_id WHERE q.id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM question WHERE id IN #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM question WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM question WHERE bank_id = #{bankId}
mapper.update: UPDATE question SET bank_id = NULL WHERE bank_id = #{bankId}
mapper.select: SELECT q.type AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM question q WHERE q.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY q.type
SELECT q.difficulty AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM question q WHERE q.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY q.difficulty

SELECT IFNULL(c.name, '未分类') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM question q LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = q.category_id WHERE q.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY IFNULL(c.name, '未分类') ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 10
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question (user_id, category_id, bank_id, type, title, options, answer, analysis, difficulty, tags, source) VALUES (#{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{bankId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{options}, #{answer}, #{analysis}, #{difficulty}, #{tags}, #{source})
